explain.kvah: kVAh is the total electricity your factory drew, including the part that does no useful work. HT bills are charged in kVAh.
explain.pf: Power factor is kWh divided by kVAh. Close to 1 is good. Below 0.90 can add a penalty to your bill.
explain.mdKva: Maximum demand is the highest load your factory reached in the month. Demand charges are based on it.

health.title: Bill health check: {{month}}

fix.power_factor: Fit an automatic power factor correction (APFC) panel and keep power factor close to 1. A fixed capacitor bank that over-corrects now raises the bill.
fix.peak_use: Move shiftable work out of 6-10 am and 6-10 pm into 10 am-6 pm.
fix.contracted_demand: Ask TGSPDCL to reduce contracted demand closer to your real maximum demand.
fix.minimum_charges: Your use is below the minimum billed units; check the contracted demand.
fix.lt_surcharges: Your bill carries a power factor or capacitor surcharge; fit a capacitor.

kvah.line: kVAh: all the power your unit draws, including power that does no useful work. HT bills charge on this.

powerFactor.line: Power factor: how much of the power you pay for does useful work. HT bills charge on kVAh, so a low power factor costs extra, and a fixed capacitor bank that over-corrects now raises the bill too.

maximumDemand.line: Maximum demand: the highest load (kVA) your unit drew at one time in the bill month.

contractedDemand.line: Contracted demand: the load (kVA) you agreed with the DISCOM. You pay demand charges on it even if you use less.

peakHours.line: Peak hours: times of day when each unit costs more under the time-of-day tariff.
